intro: Lesson 77: Calculate angles. To understand how to calculate angles on a straight line, around a point and vertically opposite

questions.q: Lines cross; one angle 120°. Find the others.
On a line: 2 equal angles and 50°.
Find a, b, c on the sheet (crossing lines with 35°).
questions.model: Teacher: a is on a line with 35°: 145°.

questions.q: Three lines meet at a point: angles 2x, 3x and 4x. Find x and each angle.
Explain why vertically opposite angles are equal using angles on a line.
questions.a: Each one plus the same neighbour makes 180°, so they must be equal

questions.q: Lines cross at 50°. Next angle? A) 130° B) 50° C) 310°
Big question: can we find angles without measuring?
questions.a: Yes: use angle facts and give a reason for each step
